title: Collapse the _stage2 workflow twins on WAN (LTX half rides MPI-466)
description: Eight _stage2 duplicate workflows exist only because ExecutionBlocker travels DOWNSTREAM ONLY and an OUTPUT_NODE is always executed, so gating after a sampler never stopped that sampler. MPI-449 fixed both forcing paths (lazy MpiBlocker input 42b1540, lazy MpiSaveLatent.enabled fd9bdca, both live-proved) and shipped the pin, so the twins are now removable. Measured 2026-08-06: the SIX LTX twins are 119 vs 119 nodes and differ by exactly ONE widget - Input_Is_Continue false -> true - so they are pure duplication the app could inject instead of swapping filenames. The TWO WAN twins are 68->67 and 55->54 nodes, each missing Stage1_Bypass (SamplerCustom), which is the OUTPUT_NODE forcing problem and needs the lazy gates. Cross-cutting: also touches how the app resolves stage 2 (the _stage2 filename swap in commandExecutor.js and routes/comfy.js). SPLIT 2026-08-07: the LTX half is no longer this card. The user re-exported LTX as ONE graph carrying Input_Video_Latent and Output_Preview together, so the six LTX twins die inside MPI-466 as part of the int8 re-wire. What remains here is WAN: the two twins at 68->67 and 55->54 nodes, each missing Stage1_Bypass, plus the shared question of narrowing the _stage2 filename-swap path once no model needs it.
acceptance: The six LTX _stage2 files are DELETED and stage 2 is reached by injecting Input_Is_Continue instead of swapping the filename
The two WAN _stage2 files are DELETED and Stage1_Bypass is gated lazily rather than physically removed
A real two-stage generation is run THROUGH THE APP for LTX and for WAN - preview, then continue - and the stage-2 output matches what the twin produced
The _stage2 filename-swap path is removed or narrowed in commandExecutor.js / routes/comfy.js, not left dead
klein_t2i and qwen_edit still behave correctly - they consume MpiBlocker too and the pin already made it lazy
